institution.name: Serendib Commercial Bank
institution.summary: Mid-size Sri Lankan commercial bank: retail deposits and pawning, SME and corporate lending, trade finance, cards and inward remittances from Gulf migrant workers; 172 branches in Sri Lanka, a few in South India, and a desk in Dubai.

segments.label: Migrant-worker families
segments.note: Households with a member working abroad, mostly in the Gulf. Their remittances fund daily life and savings.

segments.label: Salaried employees
segments.note: Private and public sector staff with salary accounts, housing and personal loans.

segments.label: Pensioners
segments.note: Fixed-deposit savers who live on interest: sensitive to rates and to prices.

segments.label: SME importers
segments.note: Traders and manufacturers that import fuel-linked goods, machinery, medicines and food, paid through letters of credit.

segments.label: Garment and tea exporters
segments.note: Exporters to the US, UK/EU, Iraq and Russia; their goods go through the Red Sea or Suez route.

segments.label: Farmers and tea smallholders
segments.note: Paddy, vegetable and tea growers in the wet and dry zones; harvests follow the monsoons.

segments.label: Tourism and hospitality businesses
segments.note: Hotels, guesthouses and tour operators on the south and west coasts; arrivals from India, Russia and the UK.

segments.label: Fuel-dependent transport operators
segments.note: Three-wheeler, van, lorry and bus owners with vehicle loans: their margins move with diesel and petrol prices.

segments.label: India corridor customers
segments.note: Sri Lankan families and traders banking in Tamil Nadu and Kerala; trade, remittances and education fees.

regulators: Data Protection Authority of Sri Lanka
